meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按仓库风格处理 git 操作：把改动拆成多个逻辑独立的提交（原子提交），执行 rebase/squash 整理历史，并用 blame、bisect、log -S 等查找改动来源。提交前会分析状态并给出提交计划。
howto.when: 当用户提到“commit”“rebase”“squash”等关键词，或请求查找提交历史时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动拆成几个小的提交
say.note: 会先分析文件并按逻辑拆分提交。

say.text: 把当前分支变基到 main 并压缩提交
say.note: 会重写历史，若已推送需谨慎。

say.text: 查一下这个函数是谁在什么时候加的
say.note: 会用 git blame 和 log 定位提交。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as a git expert: splits changes into multiple atomic commits, performs rebase/squash history rewrites, and searches history via blame/bisect/log -S. It analyzes repo state and style before planning commits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or asks for git history lookups.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several smaller commits.
say_en.note: It will analyze the files and split logically.

say_en.text: Rebase this branch onto main and squash the commits.
say_en.note: It will rewrite history; be careful if already pushed.

say_en.text: Find who added this function and when.
say_en.note: Uses git blame and log to locate the commit.
